detail.longDescription: Hi HN I've always been drawn to puzzle and strategy games, and for a long time I've wanted to build a game of my own. While building my own version of battleship, I came across this idea of adding a super intelligent in-game AI which uses probability and statistics to reason with the board and fire its next shot. The goal was to create a set of rules & logic capable of consistently outperforming human players, much like chess engines that have evolved to surpass even the world's strongest human chess players. Thus I created WraithAI and named the game as Ghostfleet. WraithAI features: 1. Monte Carlo Simulation with Probability heatmaps: Before every turn WraithAI samples 800 possible enemy fleet configurations and aggregates them into a probability heatmap. It identifies the most likely locations of the enemy ships. 2. Bayesian Inference: After every shot it updates its beliefs and uses the information gain to draw a new heatmap. When two cells look equally likely WraithAI picks the one whose result would tell more about the hidden enemy fleet for its next turn. 3. Adaptive Strategy & defense: It adjusts its aggression based on the state of the game and has a mechanism which resists common search strategies. I would genuinely like to know how people can find patterns in its behavior. Can you outsmart & beat WraithAI? Ghostfleet also has multiplayer mode so you can play with your friends. There is a matchmaking component called TownSquare at the bottom through which you can share room codes with other players. You can play directly in your browser: 1. Play against WraithAI: https://ghostfleet.in/play?mode=wraithAI 2. Ghostfleet: https://ghostfleet.in/ 3. WraithAI Technical breakdown: https://ghostfleet.in/wraith-ai
